result.title: CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers
result.summary: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $π^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文观察多视图 3D Transformer 中部分层的跨视角注意力分布相似，据此提出免训练框架 CAR3T：复用参考视图的注意力输出，并以离线风险校准加在线动态层选择，在保留全部 token 的前提下把选定层的注意力代价从二次降为线性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按输入决定哪些层可复用状态、并建模多次复用决策的累积漂移」可供核查 LVR 中跨深度 latent 缓存与复用、相似度阈值选择及误差累积问题，但原文面向 3D 重建而非推理，迁移性需自行判断。
